lines: Wilson's usage is down lately. He played 44% of snaps over his last 3 games, against 51% for the season, with an 11% target share versus 14%.
He's scoring 7.9 PPR points per game over his last 3, on 4.3 targets and 2.0 catches a game. He has 2 total TDs this year.
Week 12 is vs DEN, which allows the 27th-most PPR points per game to WRs, but PIT's implied team total is only 17.8 points.
